backlog_summary.bootstrap_note: All currently nontradable open exceptions fail startup admission. They are not automatically a backlog held by a collector started now.
backlog_summary.global_historical_closed_backlog: NOT established: missing/other Gamma resolution statuses older than the recent window were not exhaustively scanned.

condition_lookup_diagnostics_NOT_v1_lags.warning: Condition selectors may prefer V2 lifecycle for a carried-over v1 market. Do not interpret these offsets as v1 resolution lag.

fresh_backlog.scope: All closedTime records in the bounded window, one explicitly v1 CTF token per market. Moving scan, not an atomic snapshot; no claim about older closed markets.

little_law.warning: Uses max(0, resolution_timestamp - closedTime). Not a bound on actual stop-to-resolution lag, old inactive markets, or missed WebSocket events.

request_count_scope: Current process only; resumed checkpoints and exploratory probes are excluded. Scan page counts include retained earlier pages.

open.method: Union of ascending IDs <= pivot and descending IDs > pivot; boundary pages consumed in full.

scope_warning: Full open census and full proposed/disputed cohorts; closed cohort bounded to recent days. Gamma missing/other statuses outside this window are NOT exhaustively enumerated.

v1_lag_resolution_minus_gamma_closed_sec.warning: Signed timestamp offsets, not proof of an earlier acceptingOrders transition. UMA question terminal lifecycle is an oracle-resolution proxy; condition fallback requires complete v1-only token families and no Gamma V2 position IDs.

v1_protocol_audit.cohort: Closures in the 24 hours before the main scan reference time
